title: InterType: Breaking the Single-Function Barrier in Neural Binary Type Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.26906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Variable type recovery is a critical task in binary reverse engineering, enabling downstream applications such as vulnerability discovery, malware analysis, and security enforcement. While recent Transformer-based models have demonstrated strong performance in type inference by learning instruction-level semantics, they predominantly operate within single-function boundaries (i.e. intra-procedural analysis), ignoring the rich type constraints that propagate across function calls. Empirical studies have shown that nearly 44% of variables in real-world binaries propagate across function boundaries as arguments or return values, representing a significant source of type information that intra-procedural models cannot exploit. In this paper, we propose InterType, a method that embeds inter-procedural analysis into a pre-trained Transformer model for binary type recovery. Our approach builds on CodeArt, a state-of-the-art Transformer model

translated_title: InterType：打破神经二进制类型推断中的单函数壁垒
translated_abstract: 变量类型恢复是二进制逆向工程中的一项关键任务，能够支撑漏洞发现、恶意软件分析和安全强制执行等下游应用。尽管近年来基于Transformer的模型通过学习指令级语义在类型推断中展现出强大性能，但它们主要局限于单函数边界内（即过程内分析），忽略了跨函数调用传播的丰富类型约束。实证研究表明，真实世界二进制文件中近44%的变量会作为参数或返回值跨越函数边界传播，这是过程内模型无法利用的重要类型信息来源。本文提出InterType，一种将过程间分析嵌入预训练Transformer模型以实现二进制类型恢复的方法。我们的方法构建于CodeArt——一个最先进的Transformer模型之上……
tldr: InterType将过程间分析嵌入预训练的Transformer模型中，通过利用跨函数传播的类型约束信息，打破了以往神经二进制类型推断局限于单函数内部的壁垒。
en_tdlr: InterType embeds inter-procedural analysis into a pre-trained Transformer model, breaking the single-function barrier of neural binary type inference by exploiting type constraints that propagate across function calls.
